Microsoft (MSFT) vs Apple (AAPL): on the same formula, their operating margins are 13.8 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — MSFT: $331.8B · AAPL: $478.8B
• Revenue growth — MSFT: +17.8% · AAPL: +15.1%
• Operating margin — MSFT: 46.8% · AAPL: 33.0%
• Net margin — MSFT: 40.3% · AAPL: 27.6%
• Free cash flow margin — MSFT: 20.2% · AAPL: 28.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — MSFT: 13.7% · AAPL: 5.0%

Different fiscal years: MSFT Jun 30, 2026 · AAPL Sep 26, 2026. The periods are not identical.
